title: A recursive bound for triangle Ramsey numbers
statement:
For an integer $n \ge 1$, write $r_n$ for the $n$-colour triangle Ramsey number: the least $N$ such that every colouring of the edges of the complete graph $K_N$ with $n$ colours contains a triangle whose three edges all receive the same colour. Then
\[
r_n + n \le n\,r_{n-1} + 2 .
\]
